Jordan — thanks for the attachments and the clear timeline.

High-level response: we can support a 45-minute EB cadence and I think Apr 22 (late morning PT) gives your team a little more runway after feature freeze. Proposed EB structure: 15 min targeted demo to the top three evaluation scenarios, 15 min KPI/metrics walkthrough (trial data + perf), 15 min exec Q&A and alignment on risks/fallbacks.

Sponsor mapping: I suggest pairing Alyssa Park (VP Product) with Marissa Cole (our VP of Solutions) as the primary sponsor lane, and backstop with Ben Carter for pricing/SLA conversations. I’m attaching a quick sponsor-matrix (see inline below) and will prepare a short pre-read for your execs.

Pre-req checklist (we need these at least 48 hours before the EB):
- Latest eval run results (top-10 prompts) exported to CSV (we can ingest)
- Service-level expectations (p95 latency target, expected concurrency)
- Any PII/data handling notes for the sample traffic

Next steps:
1) Jordan — confirm Apr 22 10:30–11:15 PT works for your execs.
2) I’ll send an EB invite and circulation list once we confirm; we’ll include a 15-min pre-brief for our internal sponsor.
3) Ben — can you prepare the preliminary pricing snapshot and a short note on any capacity/fallback options you want on the call?

Thanks — looping Marissa and Ben to help with sponsor onboarding and pricing notes.

—
Sofia Ivanova
Customer Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
